children.game_version: Clap and step to dotted rhythm, imitate turns without full rotation

seniors.counts: Simplify counts to emphasize downbeat only
seniors.seated_version: Practice arm movements and rhythm clapping while seated
seniors.standing_version: Perform basic two-step pattern with support, slow tempo

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Graceful, often with flowing gestures complementing the noble character
movement_profile.difficulty: Intermediate to advanced due to complex ornamentation and turns
movement_profile.footwork: Two steps per measure emphasizing the first beat with dotted rhythms; smooth transitions and elegant turns
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Performed solo or in couples on stage, with spatial patterns reflecting theatrical choreography
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Controlled, with subtle movements to maintain dignity
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: No jumps; focus on smooth, flowing movements
movement_profile.partnering: Occasionally danced by couples but primarily a solo virtuosic dance
movement_profile.posture: Upright, dignified, with controlled and ceremonious carriage

signature_moves.description: A two-step pattern per measure with a dotted rhythm and accent on the first step
signature_moves.name: Loure step

signature_moves.description: Graceful rotations integrated into the step sequences
signature_moves.name: Elegant turn

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Slow to moderate tempo with lilting, dotted rhythm emphasizing the downbeat
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid rushing the tempo; do not neglect the dotted rhythm and strong downbeat accent

music_profile.musical_form: binary dance suite form or rondo

reference_recordings.artist: Jean-Philippe Rameau, Les Arts Florissants, William Christie

reference_recordings.artist: Jean-Philippe Rameau, Les Arts Florissants, William Christie

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: dotted rhythms with anacrusis (eighth note + quarter note)
music_profile.sound_description: The loure features a slow, lilting dotted rhythm with a strong downbeat preceded by a pickup note, creating a majestic and ceremonious sound. The music often includes contrapuntal textures and dynamic contrasts, with Baroque strings and woodwinds enriched by the musette's drone-like timbre.
music_profile.vocal_style: usually instrumental; some vocal loures exist in operas

basic_steps: Begin with an anacrusis (pickup) leading into the first beat
Step emphasizing the first beat with a dotted rhythm
Perform two steps per measure with smooth transitions
Incorporate elegant turns and ornamented footwork
Maintain dignified posture and slow tempo
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on rhythm and basic steps; advanced dancers add complex ornamentation and turns
teaching.rhythm: Compound duple meter (6/4) or simple triple meter (3/4) with lilting dotted rhythms
